description: This Java class, MongoEntitiesPersistenceOperations, manages persistence operations for entities in a MongoDB-based event sourcing system within the Ditto project. It provides methods to purge entities and handles MongoDB collection interactions.

classes.name: MongoEntitiesPersistenceOperations
classes.description: Implements entity persistence operations for MongoDB, specifically targeting event source persistence. Handles creation, entity selection, and purging operations within the MongoDB context.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of MongoEntitiesPersistenceOperations.

methods.name: purgeEntity
methods.description: Purges all stored data related to a specific entity identified by EntityId.

methods.name: selectEntity
methods.description: Selects MongoPersistenceOperationsSelection objects related to the specified entity.

methods.name: purgeAllSelections
methods.description: Merges purge results for all selections related to an entity.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Performs the actual delete operation on a MongoDB collection based on a selection/filter.
